compartments.description: Individuals who are not infected and can contract the disease.
Non-symptomatic infected individuals who have contracted the disease but are not yet infectious.
Individuals who are symptomatic and capable of transmitting the disease.
Infectious deceased individuals who can still infect susceptible individuals.
Individuals who have recovered from the disease and are immune.

flows.raw_text: Susceptible individuals may die and leave the population at the background death rate (µS), or they may be infected and enter the non-symptomatic infected compartment (E) at the infection rate that is represented by the two fractions.
flows.text_span: Susceptible individuals may die and leave the population at the background death rate (µS), or they may be infected and enter the non-symptomatic infected compartment (E) at the infection rate that is represented by the two fractions.
flows.description: New susceptible individuals become non-symptomatic infected

flows.raw_text: Non-symptomatic infected individuals become infectious and symptomatic, thereby leaving the compartment and joining the symptomatic infected compartment at rate ωE.
flows.text_span: Non-symptomatic infected individuals become infectious and symptomatic, thereby leaving the compartment and joining the symptomatic infected compartment at rate ωE.

flows.raw_text: Symptomatic infectious individuals may leave the compartment via disease death (at rate αI) or through recovery (at rate γI) joining the recovered (R) compartment, where they are immune to infection.
flows.text_span: Symptomatic infectious individuals may leave the compartment via disease death (at rate αI) or through recovery (at rate γI) joining the recovered (R) compartment, where they are immune to infection.
flows.description: Infectious individuals recover from the disease

flows.raw_text: The number of infected deceased increases due to death from the disease (at rate αI), and it decreases as dead bodies lose their infectivity (at rate θD).
flows.text_span: The number of infected deceased increases due to death from the disease (at rate αI), and it decreases as dead bodies lose their infectivity (at rate θD).
flows.description: Infectious individuals die from the disease

flows.raw_text: The infected deceased compartment (D) represents the dead bodies of previously infected individuals who are still capable of infecting susceptible individuals.
flows.text_span: The infected deceased compartment (D) represents the dead bodies of previously infected individuals who are still capable of infecting susceptible individuals.
flows.description: Infected dead bodies infect susceptible individuals
